text:
carmen_ops: Heads up—vendor is proposing to holdback 12/40 H100 units for EU replenishment until we sign a revised SLA. They're offering 10 units now, 2 on a later wave. We need decision on accepting split shipment + expedited AWB or pushing for a single consolidated AWB.
tim_proc: what's the incremental cost for expediting vs sticking to sea?
oliver_vendor: expedited air quote = +7.5% surcharge + fixed EUR 4,500 AWB handling. Consolidated single AWB reduces surcharge to +5% but requires single-origin pickup window and extra warehousing. Also, customs docs need explicit warranty wording to avoid temporary import duties.
carmen_ops: timeline critical—our EU pool is at 82% utilization and certain regions will start hitting queuing policies in ~10 days. Loaners from regional depots could stave off hot queues for ~2 weeks.
dana_sre: if queues throttle, customer SLAs for latency-sensitive jobs degrade. Recommend mix: immediate loaners + air top-up for long-term capacity.
tim_proc: can we negotiate vendor share? propose Redwood covers up to 4% and vendor absorbs remainder if they failed projected ship window.
oliver_vendor: vendor offers 50/50 on surcharge if we sign conditional release acknowledging ETA slip. Otherwise they hold last 2 units.
carmen_ops: operational ask—who will be the forwarder? need depot handoff SLA in NL or FRA within 36h. Also RMA path for returns on loaners and defective arrives.
oliver_vendor: we can use SkyFreight (fast) or EuropaCargo (cheaper). SkyFreight guarantees 36h depot acceptance, EuropaCargo ~72h.
carmen_ops: SkyFreight looks necessary. can procurement get an itemized quote (air surcharge, brokerage, insurance, handling)?
tim_proc: I'll request two formal quotes and draft conditional release language tonight.
rma-bot: RMA created: RMA-7782. Please add RMA-7782 to AWB and packing photos.
dana_sre: add this manifest example to reduce customs friction: ```
AWB: SF-998-221
Pieces: 12
Declared value: EUR 240,000
RMA: RMA-7782
HS code: 8471.80 (computing machines)
Note: "Warranty/Replacement parts" attached
```
oliver_vendor: will provide sample AWB + packing list and courier agreements by EOD.
tim_proc: conditional release draft: Redwood caps expedite surcharge at +6% (Redwood pays up to +6%); vendor pays any surcharge exceeding +6% if vendor missed contracted ETA. If vendor refuses, fallback is loaners + staggered sea replenishment.
carmen_ops: ops to assemble loaner list (serials, depot availability) and check insurance for loaners. Also determine repatriation charges if loaners returned DAS.
dana_sre: I'll run quick cost vs risk calc when quotes arrive (premium vs estimated revenue loss from throttling).
oliver_vendor: understood. we'll push warehouse to print "warranty" and RMA-7782 on airwaybill to reduce customs queries.
tim_proc: action items: 1) vendor to send two courier quotes and AWB samples by EOD — @oliver_vendor; 2) procurement to circulate conditional release by 09:00 UTC tomorrow — @tim_proc; 3) ops to prepare loaner manifest and depot SLA list — @carmen_ops; 4) SRE to model queue impact and cost tradeoffs — @dana_sre. reconvene after materials.
carmen_ops: thanks — tagging #eng-logistics to coordinate depot handoff and temporary label printing. :memo:
